name: Outlook Brief
summary: What arrived, what matters, and how to reply.
description: Reads the last 24 hours of message headers from the local Outlook folder: the active threads, the one message most worth opening with the reasons it won, and three reply starters built from its subject line. Works from an .eml export made on this machine, with no connector, no OAuth and no network call. Reads message headers only: it never opens a body, never reads attachments, and never sends mail.
highlights: Active threads in the last 24 hours, newest first
The one message that matters, with the reasons it won
Three reply starters built from the subject line only
